newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR FRENCH CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR FRENCH CUP FINAL.

text.p: Teams for the French Cup final between Guingamp and Nice at Parc des Princes on Saturday:

Guingamp: 1-Angelo Hugues; 2-Jerome Foulon, 4-Marek Jozwiak, 5-Gheorghe Mihali, 3-Nicolas Laspalles; 7-Richard Lecomte, 6-Claude Michel, 8-Yannick Baret, 11-Charles-Edouard Coridon; 10-Daniel Moreira, 9-Christopher Wreh.

Nice: 1-Bruno Valencony; 2-Henri Savini, 4-Youssef Salimi, 5-Frereric Taratian, 6-Olivier Fugen, 3-Louis Gomis; 7-Frederic Gioria, 8-Thierry de Neef, 11-Roberto Onorati; 9-Andrezj Kubica, 10-Mohamed Chaouch.
